findings.title: Difficult marketing language
findings.evidence: “Leverage our multimodal generative narrative engine to synthesise bespoke, heirloom-grade story artefacts from your household's lived-experience corpus.”
findings.why: I am reading in English as a second language, so these long technical words make the service harder to understand.

findings.title: “Proceed” does not explain the result
findings.evidence: [5] link "Proceed →"
findings.why: I do not know whether this will open a new story form, use my account, or ask for payment.

findings.title: The image has no description
findings.evidence: [image (no description) 430x440]
findings.why: A description would help me understand the example image and know what the book might look like.

findings.title: No visible way to recover a forgotten password
findings.evidence: The page shows “Log in” and “Create an account”, but no “Forgot password?” link.
findings.why: If I forget the password, I do not know what to do.

findings.title: Footer links have very low contrast
findings.evidence: The bottom links “Privacy”, “Terms”, and “Contact” are very faint against the background.
findings.why: I can hardly read these links.

findings.title: Unclear error message
findings.evidence: “Error 0x80070057: profile sync incomplete.”
findings.why: I do not know what this error means, whether my account or family details are affected, or whether I should click something before creating the book.

findings.title: The warning gives no recovery steps
findings.evidence: “Error 0x80070057: profile sync incomplete.”
findings.why: I cannot tell whether the page is ready for me or still loading something in the background.

findings.title: No field for the second person's appearance
findings.evidence: [9] “What do they look like? (optional)” appears only beneath the child's section, while [10] asks “Who else is in the story?” with no appearance field.
findings.why: Bà Nội has an important appearance in our memory: a grey bun and purple áo dài. I want the story pictures to show her correctly, not only Linh.

findings.title: The character name label may restrict Vietnamese names
findings.evidence: [10] “Who else is in the story?” and its placeholder says “e.g. Grandma Rose,” with no indication that a full or culturally meaningful name is welcome.
findings.why: I need to preserve the exact Vietnamese name “Bà Nội.” The English example may make me worry the site will change it.

findings.title: Grandmother's relationship is not requested
findings.evidence: The previous step only showed [10] “Who else is in the story?” and the current memory box is the only place to explain her role.
findings.why: I want the website to understand that Bà Nội is Linh's grandmother in Vietnam, but I must explain this in a long sentence.

findings.title: Reading levels use an unexplained technical scale
findings.evidence: “Reading level” followed by “Lexile BR–200L,” “Lexile 200L–500L,” “Lexile 500L–800L,” and “Lexile 800L+”
findings.why: I know Linh reads at age four, but the numbers do not help me understand what story level she needs.

findings.title: Age four is not matched clearly
findings.evidence: “Lexile 200L–500L” is checked by default, even though the supplied child age is 4.
findings.why: I cannot tell if the default is right for Linh, and I do not want to make the story too difficult for her.

findings.title: The story text was silently cut to 200 characters
findings.evidence: The previous action reported that the story box “now only shows 200 characters; the end of what you typed was cut off”
findings.why: The end of our family memory may be missing, including details that make the story personal and correct.

findings.title: Photo upload has no visible label
findings.evidence: [30] file-upload (no label) shows only “Choose file” and “No file chosen”.
findings.why: The control does not tell me by itself that I am choosing a photo of Linh, and I am cautious about uploading family photos.

findings.title: Photo privacy and retention are not explained here
findings.evidence: “Upload a clear photo of your child's face” does not say how the photo will be stored, used, or deleted.
findings.why: I need to know what happens to a photo of my young daughter before I upload one.

findings.title: The loading screen does not explain the current step
findings.evidence: The page shows only a circular loading symbol, with no text explaining that the book is being generated.
findings.why: I cannot tell whether my action worked or whether the website is stuck, so I may leave or click again.

findings.title: There is no way to stop or leave the generation safely
findings.evidence: No “Cancel,” “Wait,” or “My books” control is visible in the main content area; only the general [4] “My books” link is present.
findings.why: I need to know I can stop waiting and check my account if the loading takes too long.

findings.title: The footer text has very low contrast
findings.evidence: “Privacy,” “Terms,” “Contact,” and “© 2026 StoryHearth Ltd.” are extremely faint against the background.
findings.why: I can hardly read these links, and I may not be able to find privacy information or help.

findings.title: The book title contains a spelling error
findings.evidence: The title is shown as “The Magical Adventrue of Linh”.
findings.why: This is my family story, and a spelling mistake in the main title makes the finished book feel cheap and not careful.

findings.title: The generated art style does not match my selection
findings.evidence: The page says “Illustration style: Pop-art comic,” although I chose the watercolour pictures.
findings.why: I selected watercolour because it felt right for a gentle bedtime story for Linh. I did not expect to receive comic pictures.

findings.title: The cover does not reflect the personal details I entered
findings.evidence: The cover shows a simple figure labelled “Linh,” with short/no visible long black hair or red ribbon, alongside a rocket and hanging red oval lights; the preview caption says “Pop-art comic.”
findings.why: Linh should be the hero, and I asked for a red ribbon, long black hair, and round cheeks. The cover also does not clearly show our Vietnamese lantern-festival memory.

findings.title: The next-page control has no text label
findings.evidence: [7] is shown only as a button labelled “›”.
findings.why: The arrow is easy to understand visually, but the exact action is not clear and it may be less useful with a screen reader.

findings.title: Completion was not clearly confirmed
findings.evidence: The previous screen had only a loading circle, and this screen does not say “Your book is ready” or clearly state that it was saved to My books.
findings.why: I was not sure whether the book had finished correctly or whether I needed to do something else.

findings.title: The final sentence is incomplete
findings.evidence: “And from that day on, whenever Linh looked up at the sky, she would always remember”
findings.why: This is the ending of Linh's book, but it does not finish the thought. It makes the story feel broken and not ready to give to a child.

findings.title: Important family and cultural details are missing from the final page
findings.evidence: The final picture shows Linh and a simple rocket-like object, but not the red star-shaped paper lantern or Bà Nội.
findings.why: I asked for a story about our family memory with Bà Nội and a red star-shaped lantern at the lantern festival. Missing these details makes the book less personal and less meaningful.

findings.title: Hardcover price is hidden behind checkout
findings.evidence: [9] link "Order hardcover" appears beside “Regenerate entire book – $4.99,” with no hardcover amount shown.
findings.why: I want to know the full cost before I go to checkout, especially because the regenerate button already shows a price.

findings.title: Possible extra charges are not explained
findings.evidence: "Hardcover book $24.99" and "20 glossy pages, printed and bound to last."
findings.why: I am in England and the price is in dollars. I need to know if this is the final cost or if postage, tax, currency conversion, or other charges will be added.

findings.title: The advertised page count does not match my book
findings.evidence: The hardcover says "20 glossy pages," but my generated online book has 9 pages.
findings.why: I would worry that I would receive a different book or extra pages I did not expect, or that some part of my story could be lost.

findings.title: No way to order the current book from pricing
findings.evidence: The only button is [6] "Start your book"; the "Hardcover book" card is not a control.
findings.why: I already made a book and do not want to start another one. I need a clear route to inspect the final order for Linh’s existing book.

findings.title: Footer text has very low contrast
findings.evidence: The footer labels "Privacy," "Terms," and "Contact" appear very pale against the background.
findings.why: I can hardly read these links, so I cannot easily check how my family information and order are handled.

findings.title: Gift wrap is selected by default
findings.evidence: checkbox "Premium gift wrap" (checked), £7.99
findings.why: I might accidentally pay £7.99 for something I did not choose, and I worry about unexpected costs.

findings.title: The displayed total does not identify tax
findings.evidence: “Total £45.97” with no separate VAT or tax line
findings.why: I need to know whether the shown total is the amount I will actually be charged.

findings.title: The currency changed without explanation
findings.evidence: Pricing showed “$24.99,” while checkout shows “Hardcover … £24.99”
findings.why: I do not know if the currency changed because I am in England, or if the price was converted. The conversion and exchange rate are not shown.

findings.title: A countdown adds pressure to the checkout
findings.evidence: “Your price is reserved for 09:57”
findings.why: It makes me hurry before I have checked the book, extras, and delivery cost.

findings.title: The full cost is learned only after ordering
findings.evidence: The £7.99 gift wrap and £12.99 shipping & handling first appear on the Checkout page.
findings.why: I cannot compare the complete value before choosing “Order hardcover.”

findings.title: Removed gift-wrap price still looks active
findings.evidence: After [6] “Premium gift wrap” is unchecked, “£7.99” remains beside it without being crossed out or labelled as removed.
findings.why: I understand the new total, but the separate £7.99 line looks as if it may still be included. I need clear proof that gift wrap costs nothing in this order.

findings.title: Very short reservation timer creates pressure
findings.evidence: The message says, “Your price is reserved for 09:42.”
findings.why: Nine minutes makes me feel that I must hurry and enter payment quickly. I need to compare the cost carefully, not feel forced.
